prompt:
Our scientific computing team uses an internal code forge to manage the 'neurosolver' project under the 'scicomp' organization. The project lead wants a full health snapshot before the quarterly review.

The forge server connection details and access token are stored in /workspace/server_credentials.json. The exact structure of what we need is described in /workspace/audit_spec.json.

Please produce a file called audit_report.json in /workspace/ that contains: the list of currently open issues (with their numbers and titles), the list of currently open pull requests (with numbers, titles, and who opened them), the detailed status of pull request #3 specifically (title, state, and author), and the names of all CI/CD secrets and variables configured for this repository.

Note that some issues and pull requests have been closed already — make sure the report only reflects what is currently open.
